turns.prompt_text: what does three-way what is the difference between a single pole and a multiple
turns.response_html: A single-pole switch controls a light or outlet from one location, while a three-way switch controls a light from two different locations. A single-pole switch has two terminals, while a three-way switch has three terminals (one common, and two travelers) to allow power to travel between the two switches. For circuits with more than two locations, you would use three-way switches paired with four-way switches.
